description.fun: Vanillite is said to have been born when the morning sun struck an icicle that wished not to melt. It breathes air at −50 °C, making snow fall around it, and it sleeps buried in snow. In warm regions households treasure it because it feels pleasantly cool to hug, though it slowly shrinks there. If the snow on its head melts away, it gets embarrassed. Designer James Turner based it on soft-serve ice cream.
description.guide: Vanillite is an Ice-type Pokémon that looks like soft-serve ice cream and is said to be born from an icicle. Its freezing breath makes snow fall around it. It evolves into Vanillish, then Vanilluxe.
description.tagline: A little soft-serve cone born from an icicle that refused to melt.

description.fun: Vanillish has been around since an ancient ice age, when its kind settled in snowy mountains to the south. It grows its icy body by drinking pure water and hides from enemies among clouds of tiny ice particles, which it also uses to freeze foes. Hot days make it melt, and although it can refreeze, the process leaves its body slightly warped. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.
description.guide: Vanillish is the evolved form of Vanillite, an Ice-type Pokémon resembling an ice cream cone. It freezes foes with ice particles and melts in hot weather. It evolves into Vanilluxe.
description.tagline: A living ice cream scoop that has lasted since the Ice Age.

description.fun: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day's sun, stick together and freeze in the cold of night. Each head has its own brain, and when both agree, or both get angry, it blasts a blizzard that buries everything in snow. It can get by even if it loses a head, and skiers and snowboarders love it. Designer James Turner drew on food mascots like the Stay-Puft Marshmallow Man.
description.guide: Vanilluxe is the final form of Vanillite, an Ice-type Pokémon with two heads, each with its own brain. It makes snow clouds inside its body and unleashes blizzards when angry.
description.tagline: A double-scoop ice cream with two brains and blizzard breath.
